build_DINOLoss: build a DINOLoss module with configurable student temperature and center momentum for DINO self-supervised learning
create_softmax_center_teacher: create softmax-centered teacher outputs by subtracting the moving average center and dividing by teacher temperature
create_sinkhorn_knopp_teacher: create a normalized teacher assignment matrix using the Sinkhorn-Knopp algorithm for uniform label distribution
run_DINOLoss_forward: run the forward pass to compute cross-entropy loss between student log-softmax and teacher softmax outputs
create_update_center: create an asynchronous moving average center update from teacher outputs with distributed all-reduce support
